scientific_integrity: Full mathematical proof and reproducible exact checks supplied. The comparison with an inaccessible early rarefaction paper remains incomplete. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for uniform without-replacement sampling of a known finite abundance census and the pairwise-difference Gini–Simpson statistic. Not a theorem about nonuniform designs, measurement error, stochastic order, or causal ecology. Older technical literature may contain equivalent identities.
title: Positive richness–Simpson covariance under finite-population rarefaction
